facts.fact: The playbook says organic law 2004-63 founds the Tunisian data protection regime: rights of persons, obligations of data controllers, INPDP formalities and sanctions.

The playbook's governance diagram shows the Instance Nationale de Protection des Donnees Personnelles as the control and compliance body beside the citizen identifier register, and describes INPDP formalities under law 2004-63.
facts.system: Instance Nationale de Protection des Donnees Personnelles (INPDP)
